intro.en: A mother and her son Sami talk about the weather outside. It is raining, it is autumn, and Sami left his coat and umbrella behind. Learn words like sky (السَّماء), rain (تُمْطِر) and warm (دافِئ).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke ammi aur unka beta Sami bahar ke mausam ke baare mein baat karte hain. Baarish ho rahi hai, khizaan ka mausam hai, aur Sami coat aur chhatri peeche chhor aaya. Naye alfaaz: aasmaan (السَّماء), baarish (تُمْطِر), gunguna (دافِئ).
intro.ar: تَتَحَدَّثُ أُمٌّ وَابْنُها سامي عَنِ الجَوِّ في الخارِج: المَطَرُ يَنْزِل، وَالفَصْلُ خَريف، وَقَدْ تَرَكَ سامي المِعْطَفَ وَالمِظَلَّة. نَتَعَلَّمُ: السَّماء، تُمْطِر، دافِئ.

dialogue.ar: مَرْحَباً يا سامي! كَيْفَ الجَوُّ في الخارِجِ اليَوْم؟
dialogue.tr: marḥaban yā Sāmī! kayfa l-jawwu fī l-khāriji l-yawm?
dialogue.en: Hello, Sami! How is the weather outside today?
dialogue.ur: Hello Sami! Aaj bahar mausam kaisa hai?

dialogue.ar: السَّماءُ تُمْطِرُ كَثيراً يا أُمّي، وَالخَريفُ فَصْلُ المَطَر.
dialogue.tr: as-samāʾu tumṭiru kathīran yā ummī, wa l-kharīfu faṣlu l-maṭar
dialogue.en: The sky is raining a lot, Mum, and autumn is the season of rain.
dialogue.ur: Aasmaan se bahut baarish ho rahi hai ammi, aur khizaan baarish ka mausam hai.

dialogue.ar: ثِيابُكَ مُبْتَلَّةٌ! أَيْنَ مِعْطَفُكَ؟
dialogue.tr: thiyābuka mubtallatun! ayna miʿṭafuk?
dialogue.en: Your clothes are wet! Where is your coat?
dialogue.ur: Tumhare kapde geelay hain! Tumhara coat kahan hai?

dialogue.ar: تَرَكْتُهُ في المَدْرَسَة.
dialogue.tr: taraktuhu fī l-madrasa
dialogue.en: I left it at school.
dialogue.ur: Main use school mein chhor aaya.

dialogue.ar: وَأَيْنَ مِظَلَّتُكَ؟
dialogue.tr: wa ayna miẓallatuk?
dialogue.en: And where is your umbrella?
dialogue.ur: Aur tumhari chhatri kahan hai?

dialogue.ar: تَرَكْتُها عِنْدَ صَديقي.
dialogue.tr: taraktuhā ʿinda ṣadīqī
dialogue.en: I left it at my friend's.
dialogue.ur: Main use apne dost ke paas chhor aaya.

dialogue.ar: هاكَ كَأْسَ حَليبٍ دافِئ يا بُنَيَّ.
dialogue.tr: hāka kaʾsa ḥalībin dāfiʾ yā bunayya
dialogue.en: Here is a glass of warm milk, my son.
dialogue.ur: Yeh lo garm doodh ka gilaas, beta.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً يا أُمّي، جَزاكِ اللهُ خَيْراً.
dialogue.tr: shukran yā ummī, jazāki llāhu khayrā
dialogue.en: Thank you, Mum, may Allah reward you with good.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya ammi, Allah aap ko jazaye khair de.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ نَخْرُجُ إِلى السّوقِ بَعْدَ قَليل؟
dialogue.tr: hal nakhruju ilā s-sūqi baʿda qalīl?
dialogue.en: Shall we go out to the market in a little while?
dialogue.ur: Kya hum thori der baad bazaar chalen?

dialogue.ar: لا يا أُمّي، المَطَرُ كَثيرٌ في الخارِج.
dialogue.tr: lā yā ummī, l-maṭaru kathīrun fī l-khārij
dialogue.en: No, Mum, there is a lot of rain outside.
dialogue.ur: Nahin ammi, bahar baarish bahut hai.

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ سَنَبْقى في البَيْتِ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَة.
dialogue.tr: idhan sa-nabqā fī l-bayti hādhihi l-layla
dialogue.en: Then we will stay at home tonight.
dialogue.ur: To hum aaj raat ghar mein rahenge.

dialogue.ar: إِنْ شاءَ الله، يَكونُ الجَوُّ جَميلاً غَداً فَنَشْتَري حاجاتِنا مِنَ السّوق.
dialogue.tr: in shāʾa llāh, yakūnu l-jawwu jamīlan ghadan fa-nashtarī ḥājātinā mina s-sūq
dialogue.en: If Allah wills, the weather will be nice tomorrow and we will buy our things from the market.
dialogue.ur: In shaa Allah, kal mausam acha hoga aur hum bazaar se apna saamaan khareedenge.

dialogue.ar: فِكْرَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ يا سامي.
dialogue.tr: fikratun ṭayyiba yā Sāmī
dialogue.en: A good idea, Sami.
dialogue.ur: Achi tarkeeb hai Sami.

q.en: Which season is it in Dialogue 1?
q.ur: Mukaalma 1 mein kaun sa mausam hai?
q.ar: في أَيِّ فَصْلٍ هُمْ في الحِوارِ الأَوَّل؟

q.en: Where did Sami leave his umbrella (المِظَلَّة)?
q.ur: Sami ne apni chhatri (المِظَلَّة) kahan chhori?

q.en: What does تُمْطِرُ mean?
q.ur: تُمْطِرُ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: When will they go to the market?
q.ur: Woh bazaar kab jayenge?

q.en: What does هذِهِ فِكْرَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ mean?
q.ur: هذِهِ فِكْرَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ ka kya matlab hai?

title.en: Dialogue 2: A phone call about the weather
title.ur: Mukaalma 2: Phone par mausam ki baat

intro.en: Huda calls her sister Sara from Moscow. They talk about cold and hot weather and the temperature. Learn hot (حارّ), cold (بارِد), moderate (مُعْتَدِل) and below zero (تَحْتَ الصِّفْر).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Huda Moscow se apni behan Sara ko phone karti hai. Dono mausam, sardi garmi aur darja-e-hararat ki baat karti hain. Naye alfaaz: garm (حارّ), thanda (بارِد), mo'tadil (مُعْتَدِل), sifar se neeche (تَحْتَ الصِّفْر).
intro.ar: تَتَّصِلُ هُدى بِأُخْتِها سارَةَ مِنْ مُوسْكو، وَتَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنِ الجَوِّ البارِدِ وَالحارِّ وَدَرَجَةِ الحَرارَة. نَتَعَلَّمُ: حارّ، بارِد، مُعْتَدِل، تَحْتَ الصِّفْر.

dialogue.ar: أَهْلاً يا سارَة! هُدى تَتَكَلَّمُ مِنْ مُوسْكو.
dialogue.tr: ahlan yā Sāra! Hudā tatakallamu min Mūskū
dialogue.en: Hello, Sara! Huda is speaking from Moscow.
dialogue.ur: Hello Sara! Huda Moscow se baat kar rahi hai.

dialogue.ar: أَهْلاً وَسَهْلاً يا هُدى! كَيْفَ الجَوُّ عِنْدَكُمْ في مُوسْكو؟
dialogue.tr: ahlan wa sahlan yā Hudā! kayfa l-jawwu ʿindakum fī Mūskū?
dialogue.en: Welcome, Huda! How is the weather with you in Moscow?
dialogue.ur: Khush amdeed Huda! Moscow mein mausam kaisa hai?

dialogue.ar: في فَصْلِ الشِّتاءِ يَكونُ الجَوُّ عِنْدَنا بارِداً جِدّاً.
dialogue.tr: fī faṣli sh-shitāʾi yakūnu l-jawwu ʿindanā bāridan jiddan
dialogue.en: In the winter season the weather with us is very cold.
dialogue.ur: Sardiyon ke mausam mein hamare yahan mausam bahut thanda hota hai.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ دَرَجَةُ الحَرارَةِ هُناك؟
dialogue.tr: kam darajatu l-ḥarārati hunāk?
dialogue.en: What is the temperature there?
dialogue.ur: Wahan darja-e-hararat kitna hai?

dialogue.ar: هِيَ تَحْتَ الصِّفْرِ بِعَشْرِ دَرَجات. وَكَيْفَ الجَوُّ في جُدَّة؟
dialogue.tr: hiya taḥta ṣ-ṣifri bi-ʿashri darajāt. wa kayfa l-jawwu fī Judda?
dialogue.en: It is ten degrees below zero. And how is the weather in Jeddah?
dialogue.ur: Sifar se das darje neeche hai. Aur Jeddah mein mausam kaisa hai?

dialogue.ar: في الصَّيْفِ كانَ الجَوُّ عِنْدَنا حارّاً، أَمّا اليَوْمَ فَهُوَ مُعْتَدِل.
dialogue.tr: fī ṣ-ṣayfi kāna l-jawwu ʿindanā ḥārran, ammā l-yawma fa-huwa muʿtadil
dialogue.en: In summer the weather with us was hot, but today it is moderate.
dialogue.ur: Garmiyon mein hamare yahan mausam garm tha, lekin aaj mo'tadil hai.

dialogue.ar: قولي لي، ما هِيَ دَرَجَةُ الحَرارَةِ عِنْدَكُمْ في جُدَّة؟
dialogue.tr: qūlī lī, mā hiya darajatu l-ḥarārati ʿindakum fī Judda?
dialogue.en: Tell me, what is the temperature with you in Jeddah?
dialogue.ur: Mujhe batayen, Jeddah mein aap ke yahan darja-e-hararat kitna hai?

dialogue.ar: عِشْرونَ دَرَجَة، الحَمْدُ لله.
dialogue.tr: ʿishrūna daraja, al-ḥamdu li-llāh
dialogue.en: Twenty degrees, praise be to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Bees darje, alhamdulillah.

dialogue.ar: وَأَيْنَ سَتَقْضينَ عُطْلَةَ الشِّتاء؟
dialogue.tr: wa ayna sa-taqḍīna ʿuṭlata sh-shitāʾ?
dialogue.en: And where will you spend the winter holiday?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap sardiyon ki chhutti kahan guzarengi?

dialogue.ar: إِنْ شاءَ الله، سَأَذْهَبُ لِأَقْضِيَ العُطْلَةَ مَعَ جَدَّتي في القاهِرَة.
dialogue.tr: in shāʾa llāh, sa-adhhabu li-aqḍiya l-ʿuṭlata maʿa jaddatī fī l-Qāhira
dialogue.en: If Allah wills, I will go to spend the holiday with my grandmother in Cairo.
dialogue.ur: In shaa Allah, main chhutti apni nani/dadi ke saath Qahira mein guzarne jaungi.

vocab.ur: mo'tadil, na zyada garm na thanda

q.en: How is the weather in Moscow in Dialogue 2?
q.ur: Dusre mukaalme mein Moscow ka mausam kaisa hai?
q.ar: كَيْفَ الجَوُّ في مُوسْكو في الحِوارِ الثّاني؟

q.en: What does تَحْتَ الصِّفْرِ mean?
q.ur: تَحْتَ الصِّفْرِ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What is the temperature in Jeddah?
q.ur: Jeddah mein darja-e-hararat kitna hai?

q.en: Where will Sara spend her holiday?
q.ur: Sara apni chhutti kahan guzaregi?

q.en: What does مُعْتَدِلٌ mean?
q.ur: مُعْتَدِلٌ ka matlab kya hai?

title.ur: Mukaalma 3: Hafte ki chhutti ka plan

intro.en: Osama and Faisal plan their weekend. It is spring, so the weather is mild, but summer and its heat are coming. They decide to go to the beach and bring a tent and some food. Learn summer (الصَّيْف), spring (الرَّبيع), tent (خَيْمَة) and beach (شاطِئ).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Osama aur Faisal apni hafte ki chhutti ka plan banate hain. Bahar ka mausam hai, mausam mo'tadil hai, lekin garmiyan aane wali hain. Woh saahil par jaane ka faisla karte hain aur khaima aur khaana layenge. Naye alfaaz: garmiyon (الصَّيْف), bahar (الرَّبيع), khaima (خَيْمَة), saahil (شاطِئ).
intro.ar: يُخَطِّطُ أُسامَةُ وَفَيْصَلٌ لِعُطْلَةِ الأُسْبوع. الفَصْلُ رَبيعٌ وَالجَوُّ مُعْتَدِل، وَسَيَأْتي الصَّيْفُ وَالحَرُّ قَريباً، فَيُقَرِّرانِ الذَّهابَ إِلى الشّاطِئِ وَحَمْلَ خَيْمَةٍ وَطَعام. نَتَعَلَّمُ: الصَّيْف، الرَّبيع، خَيْمَة، شاطِئ.

dialogue.ar: ما أَجْمَلَ الجَوَّ اليَوْمَ يا فَيْصَل!
dialogue.tr: mā ajmala l-jawwa l-yawma yā Fayṣal!
dialogue.en: How lovely the weather is today, Faisal!
dialogue.ur: Aaj mausam kitna pyaara hai Faisal!

dialogue.ar: نَعَم، نَحْنُ في فَصْلِ الرَّبيع، لا حَرَّ وَلا بَرْد.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, naḥnu fī faṣli r-rabīʿ, lā ḥarra wa lā bard
dialogue.en: Yes, we are in the spring season, no heat and no cold.
dialogue.ur: Haan, hum bahar ke mausam mein hain, na garmi na sardi.

dialogue.ar: سَيَأْتي فَصْلُ الصَّيْفِ قَريباً، وَيَأْتي الحَرّ.
dialogue.tr: sa-yaʾtī faṣlu ṣ-ṣayfi qarīban, wa yaʾtī l-ḥarr
dialogue.en: The summer season will come soon, and the heat will come.
dialogue.ur: Garmiyon ka mausam jaldi aayega aur garmi aa jayegi.

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ نَقْضي عُطْلَةَ الأُسْبوعِ في مَكانٍ جَميل. إِلى أَيْنَ نَذْهَب؟
dialogue.tr: idhan naqḍī ʿuṭlata l-usbūʿi fī makānin jamīl. ilā ayna nadhhab?
dialogue.en: Then let us spend the weekend in a beautiful place. Where shall we go?
dialogue.ur: To hafte ki chhutti kisi khoobsurat jagah guzaarte hain. Kahan chalen?

dialogue.ar: ما رَأْيُكَ في البَرّ؟ هُوَ هادِئٌ وَواسِع.
dialogue.tr: mā raʾyuka fī l-barr? huwa hādiʾun wa wāsiʿ
dialogue.en: What do you think of the desert? It is quiet and wide.
dialogue.ur: Barr ke baare mein aap ki kya raaye hai? Woh khaamosh aur khula hai.

dialogue.ar: البَرُّ بَعيدٌ يا أُسامَة، فَالطَّريقُ طَويل.
dialogue.tr: al-barru baʿīdun yā Usāma, fa-ṭ-ṭarīqu ṭawīl
dialogue.en: The desert is far, Osama, the road is long.
dialogue.ur: Barr door hai Osama, raasta lamba hai.

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ نَذْهَبُ إِلى الشّاطِئ، فَهُوَ قَريبٌ مِنَ البَيْت.
dialogue.tr: idhan nadhhabu ilā sh-shāṭiʾ, fa-huwa qarībun mina l-bayt
dialogue.en: Then we go to the beach, it is near the house.
dialogue.ur: To hum saahil par chalte hain, woh ghar ke qareeb hai.

dialogue.ar: فِكْرَةٌ حَسَنَة! سَأُحْضِرُ التَّمْرَ وَالعِنَبَ وَالقَهْوَة.
dialogue.tr: fikratun ḥasana! sa-uḥḍiru t-tamra wa l-ʿinaba wa l-qahwa
dialogue.en: A good idea! I will bring dates, grapes and coffee.
dialogue.ur: Achi tarkeeb! Main khajoor, angoor aur coffee layunga.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا سَأُحْضِرُ الخَيْمَةَ وَالشّاي.
dialogue.tr: wa anā sa-uḥḍiru l-khayma wa sh-shāy
dialogue.en: And I will bring the tent and the tea.
dialogue.ur: Aur main khaima aur chai layunga.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَحْضُرُ أُسْرَتُكَ مَعَنا؟
dialogue.tr: hal taḥḍuru usratuka maʿanā?
dialogue.en: Will your family come with us?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ka khandaan hamare saath aayega?

dialogue.ar: طَبْعاً، أُسْرَتي كُلُّها سَتَحْضُر، فَاطْلُبْ مِنْ أُسْرَتِكَ أَنْ تَحْضُرَ أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: ṭabʿan, usratī kulluhā sa-taḥḍur, fa-uṭlub min usratika an taḥḍura ayḍan
dialogue.en: Of course, my whole family will come, so ask your family to come too.
dialogue.ur: Zaroor, mera saara khandaan aayega, aap bhi apne khandaan ko bulayen.

dialogue.ar: يا لَها مِنْ عُطْلَةٍ جَميلَة، إِنْ شاءَ الله!
dialogue.tr: yā lahā min ʿuṭlatin jamīla, in shāʾa llāh!
dialogue.en: What a lovely holiday it will be, God willing!
dialogue.ur: Kitni pyaari chhutti hogi, in shaa Allah!

vocab.ur: woh haazir hota hai, aata hai

q.en: Which season is it in Dialogue 3?
q.ur: Mukaalma 3 mein kaun sa mausam hai?
q.ar: في أَيِّ فَصْلٍ هُمْ في الحِوارِ الثّالِث؟

q.en: Where do Osama and Faisal decide to go?
q.ur: Osama aur Faisal kahan jaane ka faisla karte hain?
q.ar: إِلى أَيْنَ يُقَرِّرُ أُسامَةُ وَفَيْصَلٌ أَنْ يَذْهَبا؟

q.en: Why do they not go to the desert?
q.ur: Woh barr (registan) kyun nahin jaate?

q.en: What will Osama bring?
q.ur: Osama kya layega?

q.en: What does خَيْمَةٌ mean?
q.ur: خَيْمَةٌ ka matlab kya hai?

title.ur: Mausam, waqt aur jagah ke alfaaz

intro.en: This lesson has extra words. Learn the words for place (in, above, under, in front of, behind, right, left) and for time (year, month, week, day). Practice naming the four seasons too.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum jagah batane wale alfaaz seekhenge (andar, upar, neeche, aage, peeche, daayen, baayen) aur waqt ke alfaaz (saal, mahina, hafta, din). Chaaron mausamon ke naam bhi yaad karenge.
intro.ar: كَلِماتٌ إِضافِيَّة: كَلِماتُ المَكانِ (في، فَوْقَ، تَحْتَ، أَمامَ، خَلْفَ، يَمين، شِمال) وَكَلِماتُ الزَّمَنِ (سَنَة، شَهْر، أُسْبوع، يَوْم). نُسَمّي أَيْضاً الفُصولَ الأَرْبَعَة.

q.en: What does تَحْتَ mean?
q.ur: تَحْتَ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means "behind"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "peeche" ka matlab deta hai?

q.en: Which is the longest period of time?
q.ur: In mein sab se lamba waqt kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ على أَطْوَلِ مُدَّةٍ مِنَ الزَّمَن؟

q.en: What does أُسْبوعٌ mean?
q.ur: أُسْبوعٌ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means "to the right of"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "daayen taraf" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ على جِهَةِ اليَمين؟

title.en: Grammar patterns: I will bring, I left it, how much

intro.en: Learn useful sentence patterns. سَـ before a verb means "will" (سَأُحْضِرُ = I will bring). تَرَكْتُهُ / تَرَكْتُها = "I left it" (-hu for masculine, -hā for feminine). كَمْ دَرَجَةُ الحَرارَةِ؟ = What is the temperature?
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum jumlay banane ke aham tareeqay seekhenge. Fe'l se pehle سَـ ka matlab "gaa/gi" hai (سَأُحْضِرُ = main laaonga). تَرَكْتُهُ / تَرَكْتُها = "maine usay chhor diya" (muzakkar ke liye -hu, muannas ke liye -hā). كَمْ دَرَجَةُ الحَرارَةِ؟ = Darja-e-hararat kitna hai?
intro.ar: نَتَعَلَّمُ تَراكيبَ مُفيدَة. السّينُ قَبْلَ الفِعْلِ تَدُلُّ على المُسْتَقْبَل (سَأُحْضِرُ). وَنَقولُ تَرَكْتُهُ لِلْمُذَكَّرِ وَتَرَكْتُها لِلْمُؤَنَّث. وَنَسْأَلُ: كَمْ دَرَجَةُ الحَرارَة؟

I left it (f.) in the car
what is the temperature in Riyadh?

q.en: What does سَأُحْضِرُ mean?
q.ur: سَأُحْضِرُ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which sentence asks about the temperature?
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla darja-e-hararat poochta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ دَرَجَةِ الحَرارَة؟

q.en: Which fits: "The umbrella (feminine) — I left ___ in the car"?
q.ur: Kaun sa theek hai: "Chhatri (muannas) — maine ___ gaari mein chhori"?

options: Shall we go to the market now?

title.en: Sounds and listening: ض and ظ
title.ur: Aawazein aur sunna: ض aur ظ

intro.en: Listen and repeat two similar letters: ض (Dād) and ظ (Zā'). ض is made with the side of the tongue, ظ with the tip between the teeth. Then listen to a few short passages and answer questions.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum do milte julte huroof ض (Dād) aur ظ (Zā) ko sun kar dohrayenge. ض zaban ke kinare se aur ظ zaban ki nok daanton ke beech rakh kar bola jata hai. Phir chhoti chhoti baatein sun kar sawalon ke jawab denge.
intro.ar: نَسْتَمِعُ وَنُكَرِّرُ حَرْفَيْنِ مُتَشابِهَيْن: الضّادَ وَالظّاء. تَخْرُجُ الضّادُ مِنْ جانِبِ اللِّسان، وَالظّاءُ مِنْ طَرَفِهِ بَيْنَ الأَسْنان. ثُمَّ نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى فِقَراتٍ قَصيرَةٍ وَنُجيبُ.

q.en: Which letter is in the word فَضْلٌ?
q.ur: فَضْلٌ lafz mein kaun sa harf hai?

q.en: Which letter is in the word ظَهيرٌ?
q.ur: ظَهيرٌ lafz mein kaun sa harf hai?

q.en: Which word contains ض?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein ض hai?

q.en: Which word contains ظ?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein ظ hai?

intro.en: Practise asking and answering with a friend using the examples. Ask about the weather and temperature in a city, where to spend the holiday, and what to do tonight.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum dost ke saath misaalon ki tarah sawal jawab ki mashq karenge. Kisi shehar ka mausam aur darja-e-hararat poochna, chhutti kahan guzarni hai, aur aaj raat kya karna hai.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ مَعَ صَديقٍ على السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ بِالأَمْثِلَة: نَسْأَلُ عَنِ الجَوِّ وَدَرَجَةِ الحَرارَةِ في مَدينَة، وَأَيْنَ نَقْضي الإِجازَة، وَماذا نَفْعَلُ اللَّيْلَة.

dialogue.ar: ما حالُ الجَوِّ اليَوْمَ في الرِّياض؟
dialogue.tr: mā ḥālu l-jawwi l-yawma fī r-Riyāḍ?
dialogue.en: What is the state of the weather today in Riyadh?
dialogue.ur: Aaj Riyadh mein mausam ka kya haal hai?

dialogue.ar: في الرِّياضِ يَكونُ الجَوُّ حارّاً جِدّاً الآن.
dialogue.tr: fī r-Riyāḍi yakūnu l-jawwu ḥārran jiddan l-ān
dialogue.en: In Riyadh the weather is very hot now.
dialogue.ur: Riyadh mein is waqt mausam bahut garm hai.

dialogue.ar: وَما هِيَ دَرَجَةُ الحَرارَةِ هُناكَ في هذا الوَقْت؟
dialogue.tr: wa mā hiya darajatu l-ḥarārati hunāka fī hādhā l-waqt?
dialogue.en: And what is the temperature there at this time?
dialogue.ur: Aur is waqt wahan darja-e-hararat kitna hai?

dialogue.ar: دَرَجَةُ الحَرارَةِ هُناكَ أَرْبَعون.
dialogue.tr: darajatu l-ḥarārati hunāka arbaʿūn
dialogue.en: The temperature there is forty.
dialogue.ur: Wahan darja-e-hararat chalees hai.

dialogue.ar: أَيْنَ سَنَقْضي إِجازَةَ الصَّيْف؟
dialogue.tr: ayna sa-naqḍī ijāzata ṣ-ṣayf?
dialogue.en: Where will we spend the summer holiday?
dialogue.ur: Hum garmiyon ki chhutti kahan guzarenge?

dialogue.ar: لِنَذْهَبْ إِلى لَنْدَن.
dialogue.tr: li-nadhhab ilā Landan
dialogue.en: Let us go to London.
dialogue.ur: Chalo London chalte hain.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا لَنْدَن؟
dialogue.tr: limādhā Landan?
dialogue.en: Why London?
dialogue.ur: London kyun?

dialogue.ar: لِأَنَّ الجَوَّ فيها مُعْتَدِلٌ في الصَّيْف.
dialogue.tr: li-anna l-jawwa fīhā muʿtadilun fī ṣ-ṣayf
dialogue.en: Because the weather there is moderate in summer.
dialogue.ur: Kyunke wahan garmiyon mein mausam mo'tadil hota hai.

dialogue.ar: لكِنَّ لَنْدَنَ بَعيدَة. ما رَأْيُكَ في تونُس؟
dialogue.tr: lākinna Landana baʿīda. mā raʾyuka fī Tūnus?
dialogue.en: But London is far. What do you think of Tunisia?
dialogue.ur: Lekin London door hai. Tunisia ke baare mein kya khayal hai?

dialogue.ar: تونُسُ حارَّةٌ جِدّاً في الصَّيْف، وَلَنْدَنُ أَجْمَلُ.
dialogue.tr: Tūnusu ḥārratun jiddan fī ṣ-ṣayf, wa Landanu ajmal
dialogue.en: Tunisia is very hot in summer, and London is nicer.
dialogue.ur: Tunisia garmiyon mein bahut garm hai, aur London behtar hai.

dialogue.ar: اِتَّفَقْنا يا صَديقي، سَنَقْضي الإِجازَةَ في لَنْدَن.
dialogue.tr: ittafaqnā yā ṣadīqī, sa-naqḍī l-ijāzata fī Landan
dialogue.en: Agreed, my friend, we will spend the holiday in London.
dialogue.ur: Tai ho gaya mere dost, hum chhutti London mein guzarenge.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ ذلِكَ نَزورُ مَكَّةَ، إِنْ شاءَ الله.
dialogue.tr: wa baʿda dhālika nazūru Makka, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: And after that we will visit Makkah, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Aur uske baad hum Makkah ki ziyarat karenge, in shaa Allah.

q.ur: لِماذا؟ ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: Read four short passages about the seasons: spring with Hazim, autumn with Ibrahim, summer with Malik, and winter with Salih. Then answer the questions about each.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum mausamon par chaar chhote paragraph parhenge: bahar (Hazim), khizaan (Ibrahim), garmi (Malik) aur sardi (Salih). Phir har paragraph ke sawalon ke jawab denge.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ أَرْبَعَ فِقَراتٍ عَنِ الفُصول: الرَّبيعُ مَعَ حازِم، وَالخَريفُ مَعَ إِبْراهيم، وَالصَّيْفُ مَعَ مالِك، وَالشِّتاءُ مَعَ صالِح. ثُمَّ نُجيبُ عَنْ كُلِّ فِقْرَة.

q.en: In the first passage, what does Hazim read in the tent?
q.ur: Pehle paragraph mein Hazim khaime mein kya parhta hai?
q.ar: في الفِقْرَةِ الأولى، ماذا يَقْرَأُ حازِمٌ في الخَيْمَة؟

q.en: Why does Ibrahim not go to work today (autumn passage)?
q.ur: Ibrahim aaj kaam par kyun nahin jata (khizaan wala paragraph)?
q.ar: لِماذا لا يَذْهَبُ إِبْراهيمُ إِلى العَمَلِ اليَوْم؟

options: There is a lot of rain outside

q.en: How does Malik's family go to Pakistan?
q.ur: Malik ki family Pakistan kaise jati hai?

q.en: Where will Salih go for Umrah and prayer?

q.en: What does لا يُحِبُّ mean?
q.ur: لا يُحِبُّ ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: Join letters to make words, arrange letters, match word pairs to make phrases and put words in order to make sentences. Also learn six colours: blue, red, black, green, white and yellow.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum huroof jodkar alfaaz banayenge, huroof ko tarteeb denge, do alfaaz milakar tarkeeb banayenge aur alfaaz ko tarteeb dekar jumlay banayenge. Saath hi chhe rang seekhenge: neela, laal, kaala, hara, safaid aur peela.
intro.ar: نَصِلُ الحُروفَ لِنُكَوِّنَ كَلِمات، وَنُرَتِّبُ الحُروف، وَنَصِلُ كَلِماتٍ لِنُكَوِّنَ عِبارات، وَنُرَتِّبُ الكَلِماتِ لِنَكْتُبَ جُمَلاً. وَنَتَعَلَّمُ سِتَّةَ أَلْوان: الأَزْرَق، الأَحْمَر، الأَسْوَد، الأَخْضَر، الأَبْيَض، الأَصْفَر.

q.en: What does أَخْضَرُ mean?
q.ur: أَخْضَرُ ka matlab kya hai?

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "safaid" ka matlab deta hai?

q.en: Put in order: الرَّبيعِ / هذا / فَصْلُ
q.ur: Tarteeb dein: الرَّبيعِ / هذا / فَصْلُ

intro.en: A review test of words and sentences from earlier units. Try the exercises, then check yourself with the answer pages.
intro.ur: Pichhle units ke alfaaz aur jumlon ka dohraai test. Mashqein karein, phir jawab wale safhon se apna kaam check karein.
intro.ar: اِخْتِبارُ مُراجَعَةٍ لِكَلِماتٍ وَجُمَلٍ مِنَ الوَحَداتِ السّابِقَة. نَحُلُّ التَّمارينَ ثُمَّ نُصَحِّحُ بِأَنْفُسِنا.
